title: Configuration verification
boundary: Queue acceptance, provider acceptance, human observations and business acceptance are separate. No status here proves a message was read. Recording evidence sends no message and runs no external probe.
saved: Saved configuration; not revalidated by this read. Existing configuration saves may read the configured secret provider.
credential_metadata_active: Local credential metadata is active; remote expiry, account permissions and delivery remain unverified.
credential_unavailable: Credential metadata is unavailable or revoked. Historical evidence is not current.
credential_unpinned_external: This external credential lacks a pinned provider version; an exact account/version binding is unavailable.
enabled: Endpoint and worker are enabled; this is not verification evidence.
paused: Endpoint or worker is paused. Pausing does not revoke historical evidence.
currentScope: Matches the current configuration and credential epoch.
oldScope: Old or incomplete binding; not current verification evidence.
incomplete: History is incomplete. Current qualification and declaration controls remain unavailable.
manual: Manual declaration — not independent provider verification. machineVerified: false.
readError: Verification access failed. Private evidence and declaration controls are hidden.
expiresAt: Expires at (ISO 8601 UTC, at most 30 days)
realTarget: I tested this exact real target/account, not a fixture. This remains my declaration, not an independent machine verification.
approvalChecks: I checked the actual approval notification at the recipient, its detail link, login/permissions, and that a GET link cannot approve the request.
confirm: I reviewed this frozen request. Saving only records my statement; it does not send, retry or approve a notification.
unknown: Write outcome unknown. The original idempotency key and payload are retained in this tab. Do not create a replacement request. You may explicitly retry this exact declaration after reviewing it.
manualRecovery: The stored request is unreadable or belongs to another operation. Check the server ledger manually; do not clear browser storage to bypass uncertainty.
storageError: Tab storage is unavailable. No new declaration will be sent.
ownershipChanged: Another operation owns this tab marker. Reload and reconcile that operation first.
invalid: Check required aliases, full commit, UTC dates, current reviewed delivery and category confirmations.
rejected: Request rejected. Reload current permissions and evidence before preparing a new declaration.
refreshError: Declaration recorded, but the read refresh failed. Do not submit a replacement.
savedDeclaration: Declaration recorded. This is an administrator statement, not a provider certificate.
sourceReferences: Source IDs: delivery / human review / approval
